title: Simultaneous etale coordinate flags with a labelled boundary
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme over $\mathbf Q$ [def-pc-scheme], $N,C\subset Z$ closed subschemes represented by their quasi-coherent ideals [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $E=(E_0,\ldots,E_{r-1})$ a finite ordered family of such ideals. Say that $(N,C,E)$ has simultaneous etale flag coordinates if $C\subseteq N$ and for every $x\in Z$ there exist an affine scheme $W$, an etale morphism $q:W\to Z$ whose image contains $x$, and an etale $\mathbf Q$-morphism $(v_1,\ldots,v_n):W\to\mathbf A^n_{\mathbf Q}$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-sbc-affine-space], subsets $B\subseteq A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a partial assignment $b$ of boundary labels to coordinate indices, injective on its defined values, with the following properties. If $x\in N$, then $N_W$ has ideal $(v_i:i\in B)$, and otherwise its ideal is the unit ideal. If $x\in C$, then $C_W$ has ideal $(v_i:i\in A)$, and otherwise its ideal is the unit ideal. If $b(j)=a$, then $(E_j)_W$ has ideal $(v_a)$ and $a\notin B$; if $b(j)$ is undefined, then $(E_j)_W$ has unit ideal. Ideals generated by global sections mean the associated quasi-coherent ideals. Empty coordinate sets and absent labels are permitted.
